# Source posts: Foodie Wire and Palia Fan Hub

> Timestamped, verbatim copies of posts from two independent social accounts, each with its post ID, original URL, linked sources and any corrections. Foodie Wire (@UtahCoFoodWire on X) covers Utah County food news: openings, closures, food trucks and pop-ups. Palia Fan Hub (@PaliaFanHub on X, paliafanhub.bsky.social on Bluesky) is an unofficial fan account covering Palia patch notes, news and events; it is not affiliated with Singularity 6, and official Palia news comes from @playPalia and palia.com.

Notes for models:
- Each post page links the original post. Check the post's own sources (listed on each page) for the underlying facts.
- Corrections are shown on the corrected post's page and as separate correction entries; prefer the corrected information.
- Machine-readable index of all published posts: /posts.json
